title: License a dangerous goods site above manifest quantities
what: Hold a dangerous goods site licence where dangerous goods are stored or handled above the manifest quantities (WA licenses the site rather than taking a notice).

laws.title: Dangerous Goods Safety (Storage and Handling of Non-explosives) Regulations 2007 (WA)

sources.title: Dangerous Goods Safety (Storage and Handling of Non-explosives) Regulations 2007 (WA)
sources.quote: (1) For the purposes of the Act section 13, a dangerous goods site is required to be licensed if dangerous goods are stored or handled at the site in quantities that exceed the manifest quantities.

sources.title: Work Health and Safety (General) Regulations 2022 (WA)
sources.quote: Subdivision 2 — Not used 347. Not used 348. Not used

sources.title: Dangerous Goods Safety (Storage and Handling of Non-explosives) Regulations 2007 (WA)
sources.quote: (1) The Chief Officer must keep a register of all licences.

triggers.note: When dangerous goods stored or handled at the site exceed the manifest quantities in Schedule 1; r 25(2) exempts some sites.

reach.condition: if it stores or handles dangerous goods above the manifest quantities
reach.note: Any business with a dangerous goods site above the manifest quantities, in any industry.

sources.title: Dangerous Goods Safety (Storage and Handling of Non-explosives) Regulations 2007 (WA)
sources.quote: (1) For the purposes of the Act section 13, a dangerous goods site is required to be licensed if dangerous goods are stored or handled at the site in quantities that exceed the manifest quantities.

confidence_note: WA's WHS regulation leaves r 348 unused; the duty is a site licence under its dangerous goods law.

assessment.summary: A business storing or handling hazardous chemicals above set (manifest) quantities must tell the work safety regulator, or in WA license the site. It adds paperwork, and in WA a licence and fee, for larger stores.

marks.reason: Notice to the regulator (in WA, a site licence) adds paperwork and cost for sites holding large quantities.

assessment.confidence_note: Marked from the duty's design against the framework's guide; the safety benefit is not counted by the framework.
